name: agentic-harness
description: Stand up, assess, and maintain an agentic harness in an existing repo. A meta-tool that generates project-specific agent teams and the skills they use, then assesses how effectively they are used. When a spec-driven development system or an issue tracker is present, the generated orchestrator coordinates with it — activating the spec workflow and resuming on hand-back, pulling ready work and writing status back. When a repo-native tracker and a human tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues) coexist, it generates a dual-tracker sync that keeps the SaaS as a projection of the repo-native source of truth. Seven skills: harness-setup (build, extend, maintain), harness-review (read-only assessment), harness-feedback (run a kaizen retrospective and file tool-improvement feedback upstream), spec-advisor (advise and delegate setup of a spec-driven development system), tracker-advisor (advise and delegate setup of an agent-suited issue tracker), visual-advisor (choose a domain-fitting visual stack — review surface, generators, style source — with pros and cons), and harness-doctor (read-only check of the plugins, skills, MCP servers, and CLIs a harness needs, with pinned install proposals).
